content: Hemanuheri 'inɨarieya

'Akatsi, Kutani nu'aya, 'Utsiyaxi teukarieya, Kura kwieyaritsie katini'aitakaitɨni. Mɨkɨ tukaritsie Xetsini, ti'aitame Tsiriya kwieyaritsie, Pekaki Xemariyaxi nu'aya, ti'aitame 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie, Kerutsareme mekaniu'axɨani me'itamienike, matsi mɨkɨ mepɨka'ɨyɨwekaxɨa me'e'iwake.

Rawiri paratsiyuyata niuki kaniuye'ani kename Tsiriya 'Epɨrahini hamatɨa meheyutinɨkai, 'Akatsi 'iyarieya kaniwatayuani meta teɨterimama mekaniutimamani, 'ɨtsita kɨyexite 'ekakɨ kemɨtiutiyuatɨka hepaɨ.
Yawé Kitsariyaxi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Kenemie 'aniwe Tsehaxi-Yatsuwi
pe'awitɨtɨ 'Akatsi hetsɨa, haa wapaitɨ meukatuarike manuhuyeritɨarie manu'axe pekaneikaxeiyamɨkɨ, huyeta 'Ekwame Kwieya makuma huyeyari manuyehane 'utɨa.

Mɨpaɨ ketinetahɨawi meyɨ'ɨwiyanikɨ, meta kayuwatɨ meyeikanikɨ, pɨkamaka Xetsini Tsiriyu tewiyari mɨha'akɨ, meta Xemariyaxi nu'aya hɨxie pɨkamaka, mɨkɨ wahekɨ pɨkayu'iyaritɨaka huta kɨyexiyari manukɨtsiyatɨkakɨ.
Mɨpaɨtatsiere ketinetahɨawi kename 'Epɨrahini, Xemariyaxi nu'aya hamatɨa meyunɨtɨ meta Tsiriyu tewiyari, mɨpaɨ mete'uxa kename me'itamieni, mɨpaɨ memɨteku'eriwakɨ
Kura kwieyaritsie mekaniye'axɨanikeyu, mexetimariutame, mexeha'iwame manata ti'aitame Taweri nu'aya memanukakenikɨ.
Matsi neuxei mɨpaɨ ketinetahɨawi mɨpaɨ kename ne nehaine Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe:
Yawé hutarieka 'Akatsi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
―Yawé 'akakaɨyari keneutawawiri 'inɨari mɨmatsiwewirienikɨ, tsepa kwieta tetɨata paitɨ, yatsepa muyuawi meutitewatsie paitɨ.
Peru 'Akatsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: ―Ne Yawé nepɨkata'inɨata, meta tixaɨtɨ nepɨkatitawawirieni.
Hikɨ Kitsariyaxi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Xekeneu'enana hikɨ xeme Rawiri nuiwarimama. Xeme teɨteri xewa'uximatɨatɨ xepɨkatehayewaku, yaxeikɨata nekakaɨyari xe'uximatɨatɨ.
'Ayumieme Ti'aitame 'inɨari kanixewewiriemɨkɨ: 'Ɨimari kanitihukatamɨkɨ kanitiniwemɨkɨ, 'Emanuheri katiniterɨwamɨkɨ.
Kepauka 'aixɨa mɨti'ane xeikɨa mɨtinaki'erieka, 'axamɨti'ane mɨkatinaki'erieka, retsi kuneriyari xietemakame kanikwa'amɨkɨ.
Karikɨ mɨkɨ nunutsi 'aixɨa mɨti'ane katitanaki'eriwekaku 'akuxi meta 'axamɨti'ane karehɨawekaku, mɨkɨ te'aitamete memɨyuhuta pemɨwamakaxe wakwie kaniku'eiriwamɨkɨ.

»Yawé 'ahetsɨa kani'atɨamɨkɨ, meta 'ateɨterima wahetsie metatsiere 'apaapa nuiwarimama wahetsie, hatsuaku mɨkatiyɨwekai hepaɨ kepauka 'Epɨrahini Kura hamatɨa memeyutaxɨriexɨatsie paitɨ, karikɨ mɨkɨ 'Atsiriyatsie ti'aitame kanita'inimɨkɨ».
'Iya tukaritsie Yawé yuwikɨarikɨ xaipɨ kanita'inimɨkɨ 'Ekipitu hatɨayaritsie 'aheteewakaku muyeika, meta xiete kanita'inimɨkɨ 'Atsiriya kwieyaritsie muyeika.
Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ mekani'axɨakuni 'aki'utɨma meukatetewatsie mekaniyuti'ituatɨakuni, 'ai mukatataritsie, naime 'aki'utɨma muyexuyatɨkatsie meta naime haa matinenieretsie.
'Iya tukaritsie, ti'aitame 'Atsiriya kiekame hetsɨa nawaxa niɨwiekame hepaɨ 'Eupɨrata 'anutauye miemekɨ, Yawé 'Ixaheri mu'uyatsie kanikaximɨkɨ, meta huxarieya 'awie mieme metatsiere mɨxiyaya.
'Iya tukaritsie, xewitɨ tewi xeime tsikeru meta yuhutame tsipuri kaniwatiwaweriyamɨkɨ,
waɨkawa retsi mekanayexexeiyakuni retsi kunerimakame kanexeiyakamɨkɨ kɨmana mɨtiutikwa'anikɨ. Meta kemɨ'ane mana yunaitɨ kwiepa memuyuhayewa retsi kuneriyari xietemakame mekani'iekakuni.
'Iya tukaritsie, hakewa xeimiriyari kaxie kɨyeyari meku'ukai xeimiriyari pɨrata tuminiyarikɨ xewitɨ mɨraye'akai, mɨkɨ tixaɨtɨ pɨkatiyuhayewa 'ɨtsi meta xuya xeikɨa,
mɨkɨ naitsarie kwiepa kanakɨnɨmɨkɨ. Mana mɨye'anikɨ xeikɨa tupi meta 'ɨrɨ rapitɨ kaniyɨwemɨkɨ.
Mɨkɨ xuya meta 'ɨtsi pemakatɨ, hɨritetsie hakewa meripaitɨ hatsarunikɨ mɨreka'etsitɨrekaitsie pepɨkamie, mana tewaxi mematatuiwatsie kanayeimɨkɨ meta muxatsi memanu'uwatsie.
